title: Intelligent and Automatic System Interface Control System for Users with Disabilities
summary: An Ethiopian project combines vision models and eye tracking for computer control. Functional benefits for users remain intended while development continues.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: An Ethiopian project is developing computer control through vision models and eye tracking. Functional benefits for users remain intended.
purpose: Enable people with hand impairments to operate digital devices.
developer: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University

ratings.reason: People with hand or mobility impairments are intended to control computers hands-free.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 9: Intelligent and Automatic System Interface Control System for Users with Disabilities

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Mappings from recognized gestures to interface actions

headline: Eye gestures for hands-free computer control
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
